principles: Fail loud + attributed: a hung command must surface as a named per-command timeout, not a silent whole-suite force-exit
Minimal, general core change over per-smoke patching
Preserve explicit per-command timeoutMs override; do not touch the global watchdog
drivers: A silent force-exit skips re-stamping test-evidence.materialHash → blocks DONE for ALL stories
The trigger is transient load, not a deterministic bug → robustness, not a smoke rewrite
Keep the diff small and reviewable (single core file + config + smoke)

options.name: default per-command timeout in validation-executor (+ config timeoutMs on the slow smokes)
pros: Self-unblocking: fixed executor makes this story validate cleanly
cons: Must pick a default that does not kill a legit slow command (mitigated by override)

options.name: only add timeoutMs to the slow smokes in lattice.config.json
cons: Config is environment-specific; does not protect other/future commands; not a general fix

options.name: change the global idle watchdog to be per-command-aware
cons: Larger blast radius in cli-engine; riskier; the per-command timer path already exists

chosen: default per-command timeout in validation-executor (+ config timeoutMs on the slow smokes)
rationale: The per-command timer path already exists in validation-executor; making it default-on (below the global idle watchdog) is the smallest change that turns a silent whole-suite force-exit into a named per-command failure, protecting every command and self-unblocking this story.

preMortem.scenario: Default timeout too low kills a legit slow command (e.g. build under load)
preMortem.trigger: a command legitimately runs past the default
preMortem.mitigation: set default ~240s (> build ~160s with margin, < 300s global idle); document the lattice.config.json per-command timeoutMs override for legitimately long commands

preMortem.scenario: Default too high — global idle watchdog still fires first
preMortem.consequence: no improvement; still a silent whole-suite force-exit
preMortem.mitigation: assert default strictly below the cli-engine 300s idle watchdog; smoke verifies a hung command is killed by the per-command timer (exit 124) well before 300s

preMortem.scenario: Child ignores SIGTERM and keeps running
preMortem.mitigation: escalate to SIGKILL after 1s (already in validation-executor) — keep that path; smoke confirms the hung command actually terminates
